patthana14.16:1.1: Āsavañceva sāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca naāsavo ceva naanāsavo ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Āsavañceva sāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca naanāsavo ceva nano ca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Āsavañceva sāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca naāsavo ceva naanāsavo ca naanāsavo ceva nano ca āsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. (3)
patthana14.16:2.1: Sāsavañceva no ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naanāsavo ceva nano ca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi.
patthana14.16:3.1: Āsavañceva sāsavañca sāsavañceva no ca āsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca naāsavo ceva naanāsavo ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi.
